svg.aria-label: How a task moves: from your words through Focus, the plan check, the launch rule, Maker, the check and one card to your accept and your merge, every step on the ledger

g.text: Intake: the UI's box, or parallax do
Focus drafts the intent and plan
Plan checked against the intent, by code

text.tspan: asks you if over the limit or

g.text: Check: your tests, Second Eye, Field
One card: Ready, or one decision
Accept commits exactly the reviewed tree

svg.text: Every step is written to the hash-chained ledger.
